content: os.environ is a process-wide cache written back to the real process environment; in a long-lived process a write persists for every later call and every other library in the process. Documented real-world instance: wsgiref CGIHandler caching os.environ leaked data between requests. mod_wsgi guidance concludes that long-lived applications should not rely on environment variables for per-invocation configuration and should use request-scoped or context-local state instead. putenv and environ.refresh are not thread-safe.
